Dialogs.Dialog: Huh... right now？ Okay, but it's so sudden.
Nice to meet you, I'm Manaka Takane.
▲紹介友達名▲. Nice to meet you.
Sorry！ Um, could you say it once more？
▲紹介友達名▲. Nice to meet you.
I know, then could you try writing it here？
▲紹介友達名▲. Yes, very nice to meet you.
It's been a while, it's me Takane.
Excuse me, please look over here.
Um, being stared at that much is kind of...
Um... please don't stare at me like that...
Huh？ Um, aren't you a bit close？
Um, could we step back a little？
Um, it's hard to talk like this...
Um, let's all calm down a little！
Um, well, geez, that's probably enough...
Um, you don't have to think so hard about it...
Could you be his older brother？
Could you be his older sister？
Um, how do you know him？
Um... what's your, you know, relationship with him？
Then, could you be his father... Just kidding.
Then, could you be his little brother？
Um, you couldn't be his mother, could you？
Um, could you be his little sister？
Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Manaka Takane, and I'm dating him. It's very nice to meet you.
Um, he really looks like his father.
Um, nice to meet you... Mrs.
You two really look alike. Hehe.
Um, it's very nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you？ You look just like your dad, don't you？
Nice to meet you. Thank you for always looking after him.
You really do look alike. Hehe.
Um, so your family is very affectionate, then？
Let's get along from now on.
I look forward to getting to know you.
Maybe I should change my hair after all...
Then, can I ask you the same thing？
Have you known him for a long time？
Does he say anything about me？
Did he tell you about me？
It's still a little embarrassing, huh？
Is this your first time doing something like this？
This is your first time doing something like this, isn't it？
Oh, I see. He never tells me these things.
Sorry, this is how I am.
So it's not just me, hehe.
So today's the first time in a while？
I see. Then today was so sudden, wasn't it？ I'm sorry.
I see. Right？ Yeah, it's fine.
Huh？ Really？ That's a bit of a relief.
Really... that's a bit of a relief.
Um, it hasn't even been a year yet...
We haven't even been together a year yet.
It's already been over a year... that went fast.
Yes, it's been over a year.
Oh, a really long time... Just kidding.
We've been together a pretty long time now...
Um... it's because he's always there when I want to see him...
That's because he's there for me whenever I want to see him...
He's kind and warm... that's what I like. How embarrassing...
Well, it's because he's such a warm person... yes.
That's, well, because he's really cool... Just kidding.
Because he's handsome. He's really popular with the girls at school. Hehe.
That he's fun to talk to, I guess... he's so quick-witted.
Most of all, that he's quick-witted. Talking with him is always fun.
That's... um, hmm... huh？ I forgot...
Um, well... that kind of thing is, um... I'm sorry.
When I tried a new dish recently and he praised it, I guess.
When I tried a new dish and he praised it.
Getting a present the other day, I guess... from him.
He gave me a present. Lately, that's the best thing that's happened.
What made me happy was... oh, being able to spend an important day together... with him.
Spending our anniversary together... oh, as high schoolers should, of course. Yes.
The other day, he celebrated my birthday, and I was so happy he remembered...
It was my birthday the other day. He celebrated it with me...
That has to be――um... well... a secret.
What made me happiest was――um... well... a secret.
Hmm... when I don't get a text from the person I'm waiting on, I end up moping about it... it's bad of me.
I mope when I don't get a text from the person I'm waiting on, even though I'm the one choosing to wait.
Hmm... when there isn't much physical affection, I worry he might find me annoying.
Um... when there isn't much physical affection, I wonder if maybe he finds me annoying...
Lately I've been thinking how much food preferences matter. Matching tastes is hard.
Lately I've been thinking food preferences really matter. Matching tastes is hard.
Lately he takes pictures of me a lot... but, um, there are a lot of shots I don't want taken, and it's embarrassing...
Lately he takes pictures of me a lot... and sometimes, um... never mind.
Hmm... he's not very smooth about it... like, um, kissing...
Um... I wish he'd be a bit smoother about it... no, never mind...
Hmm, I know guys aren't good at casual affection... but if it's always like that, well...
I've been wanting to ask, is your family very affectionate at home？
Worries... oh, my worry is――actually, never mind...
My worry is――um, I think I'll keep it to myself.
I took lots of lessons when I was little, but the only ones I still keep up are making sweets and piano.
I took lots of lessons when I was little, but the only ones I still keep up are making sweets and piano.
My hobby is making sweets... but lately I've been focused on tennis with him.
My hobby is making sweets. But lately I've been focused on tennis with him.
I've always liked it, but lately I'm really into cooking. For the reason, ask him. Hehe.
I've always liked it, but lately I'm really into cooking. He eats so much, it makes it worth it.
Lately I often go along with him and his camera. Maybe I'll take some pictures too.
Lately I often go along with him and his camera. Instead of always being the subject, maybe I'll try taking pictures too.
I'm not a picky eater. And... what I love most is sweet potatoes...
What I like... um, I don't think I'm picky. Yes.
I've been eating a lot of Japanese food lately... so maybe I like it more than before.
Lately I often eat Japanese food with him. So I've come to like it.
There's a restaurant I go to a lot lately, so I'm studying their menu.
There's a restaurant he and I go to a lot lately, so I'm studying their menu.
I'm into Chinese food right now. Maybe because we eat it so often.
Lately it's Chinese. Because we often go out to eat it together.
Hmm... when you have someone to cook for, you naturally start to like what they like... Just kidding.
When you have someone to cook for, you end up matching their tastes... so maybe I'm becoming more like him... Just kidding.
I'm 16, a second-year in high school.
I'm 16, a second-year in high school.
I'm 17, a second-year in high school.
I'm 17, a second-year in high school.
My hair？ Is it that noticeable？
Um, it does stand out, doesn't it？ My hair？
It doesn't suit me after all... does it？ This hair？
It doesn't suit me after all？ This hair.
I like this kind of thing.
Lately, I've been wearing it like this.
He said this kind of style suits me...
I was growing it out, but I cut it the other day.
I talked it over with him and cut it... does it look weird？
I talked it over with him and tried this color... doesn't it suit me？
I talked it over with him and dyed it... does it look weird？
I see... but I like it myself...
Objectively speaking, does he have good taste？ Sometimes I worry...
As his family, what do you think of his taste？
No way... and I trusted him...
These clothes, they stand out, huh？
These clothes？ They do stand out, don't they？
You're looking again... do they stand out that much？ These clothes？
Um... do they stand out that much？ These clothes？
He picked these out for me for today...
He chose this outfit for me today.
This was a present from him...
This was a present from him. I hope it suits me...
Do you and he ever talk about what you like in girls' clothes？
Do you and he ever talk about what you like in girls' clothes？
Guys talk about that kind of thing a lot, huh...
I knew it. Always talking about that. Geez...
Do you wear clothes like this？
Do you ever wear clothes like this？
Right？ Nice, isn't it？ Looks like we have similar taste？
Oh, you like it？ Looks like we have similar taste！
Maybe something a little bolder after all...
Right？ I'll keep that in mind.
Your blood type is A, isn't it？
Your blood type is A, isn't it？
Your blood type is B, isn't it？
Your blood type is B, isn't it？
Your blood type is AB, isn't it？
Your blood type is AB, isn't it？
Your blood type is O, isn't it？
Your blood type is O, isn't it？
I knew it. You're so typical, hehe.
Right？ You're very easy to read.
Huh？ That's weird... what type are you？
Huh？ Really... what type are you？
I see... that's a little surprising...
I see... that's a little surprising.
Right？ Then I got it right！
Right, I knew it. I'm good at guessing.
Ah, that means you're the same as him. Right？
Ah, you're the same as him.
Now it's my turn. What type am I？
Then now it's my turn. What type am I？
Correct！ Sincere and logical type A, right？ We're the same！
Correct！ Fellow type A's, let's be friends！
Bzzt！ The answer is A. That's right, he and I are both type A. Maybe that's why we get along.
Too bad, the answer is type A. The same as him. Maybe that's why we get along.
Hmm... I wonder why I seem that way.
Really？ If so, maybe I'm a little happy.
Really？ I think that's the first time anyone's said that...
By the way, the answer is type A. People often say I'm typical...
Oh, then, do you believe in blood type compatibility？
Then, do you think blood type compatibility is real？
Then, what type do you think you're compatible with？
Then, what blood type do you think you're compatible with？
My father says there's no medical basis for it either. But somehow, I feel like there is.
Good. Because they're meticulous, I bet？
I see. Because they're creative, I bet？
Because they go at their own pace？
Ah, then, is there someone you like... Just kidding, hehe.
If not... maybe I shouldn't pry.
Maybe it suits you, I think I get it.
Maybe it suits you surprisingly well, I think I get it.
I see, so that's how it goes.
It's an unexpected combination, but maybe that's good too.
Then by blood type, you're perfectly compatible with him too.
Ah, then by blood type, you and he aren't such a great match...
Can I ask one thing？ ...Do you have any older siblings？
I knew it！ You seem like a younger kid. Then, an older brother？
Right？ I'm the oldest too, so I thought maybe. Then, do you have a little sister？
An older sister？ ...Ah, now that you mention it, maybe so.
Yay, I guessed right again. You're so easy to read.
Too bad... you're so nice to girls, I thought you had a little sister.
By the way, I'm an only child.
Since I have the chance, maybe I'll ask...
Since I have the chance, I'll go ahead and ask...
Has he always been like this？
Has he been like this since he was little？
Huh... I can't really picture that from how he is with me.
I can't really picture it... huh...
Is he always this active at home too？
Is he a little rascal at home too？
Is he always this laid-back at home too？
Is he a laid-back type at home too？
I knew it... so that's just how he is？
I see... then maybe he's pushing himself around me...
I can't really picture it. Huh...
When he's with me, if anything, he's pretty laid-back.
When he's with me, if anything, he's a bit of a rascal？
But sometimes he can be a little mean.
Maybe that side of him is why we get along... Just kidding.
That side of him is what I really love.
He told me you were a kind person...
He told me you were a cool person...
He told me you were a quiet person...
He told me you were a lively person...
He told me you were a serious person...
He told me you were a funny person...
But now that I've met you, if anything...
I'm glad I got to meet you today.
I was happy to meet you today.
Could you be his little brother？
Could you be his little sister？
Um... your face is a little scary...
You're kind of a cool person.
Maybe it's just my imagination, but your eyes are a little...
Being honest is nice, but I wish you'd be a little more considerate...
I feel like you're looking at a lot of things, but maybe it's my imagination.
You keep looking at all sorts of places... it makes me a little uneasy.
You stare at me so much. Not that I mind, but...
How should I put it, the touching is a little...
Um, you're really touchy... it's a bit much.
I think you touch too much. ...That's not good.
You talk at your own pace, I think.
You really go at your own pace. You talk so freely.
Do you get nervous easily？ I wish we could've talked more.
You get nervous easily, huh. We didn't get to talk much.
You're kind of a cool person.
You're a lively person, aren't you？
You're a serious person, aren't you？
Your eyes are a little... never mind. I'm sorry.
Your eyes bother me a little... sorry if it's just my imagination.
I felt like I was being watched... it made me nervous.
Being looked at... makes me nervous.
Being stared at is a little... ah, I mean it makes me nervous.
Um, the touching is a little...
Um, you really like touching, don't you？
Um, I really do think you touch too much.
You go at your own pace, don't you？ The way you talk.
You really go at your own pace, don't you？
Were you nervous, maybe？ I wish we could've talked more.
Were you nervous？ It's a shame we couldn't talk much.
Um, has anyone told you that you look like...
The one guys love right now...
The one girls love right now...
The one you always see on TV...
The one I saw in town the other day...
Huh？ I think you look just like them.
Really？ I think you look alike... sorry.
Really... I thought you looked alike.
Let's get along from now on.
I look forward to getting to know you.
